title: Just a moment...
claims: The central market concern is not that AI has stopped working, but that AI-company valuations may have risen faster than profits. Investors are questioning whether demand for processors, memory and data-center equipment can remain strong if AI businesses are less profitable than expected.

NVIDIA is especially exposed to changing expectations because its chips are central to the AI industry and its valuation depends heavily on continued infrastructure demand. AP reported that the sell-off reflects a need for earlier capital spending to translate into measurable earnings and returns.

title: OpenAI, Anthropic valuations fuel VC fears of startup correction
claims: For startups, a market reset can mean less generous valuations and more pressure to show revenue before raising money. A November 11 report said venture investors were already applying more conservative revenue multiples in AI funding discussions during the public-market sell-off.

title: Access Denied
claims: Retirement savers may see account balances move with the sell-off if their 401(k) plans or funds hold technology-heavy stocks. SEC investor guidance says stock and stock-fund values can fall quickly and that diversification can reduce, but cannot eliminate, market losses.

title: [2608.29843] The Price of Intelligence: A Quality-Adjusted Price Index for AI Services
claims: The market decline does not determine the eventual price of AI services. Separate research on AI inference markets found substantial quality-adjusted price declines, suggesting that competition and efficiency can make AI cheaper even while the companies supplying it face pressure to justify their spending.
